actions.reason: C0001 has coherent RNA and CNV identity evidence, consistently positive cross-modal membership and boundary support, and no significant technical confounder; it is retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0002 has moderate coherent RNA and CNV identity evidence with positive cross-modal membership and boundary support; a tissue-source-site association is present but does not by itself establish artifact, so the candidate is retained with this limitation noted.

C0003 has strong BAP1-driven mutation evidence and coherent immune/interferon expression support with the most consistent cross-modal membership and boundary separation; a tissue-source-site association is present but does not by itself establish artifact, so it is retained with this limitation noted.

C0004 has strong coherent PBRM1/VHL-depletion mutation evidence and positive fused boundary separation from all other sets, with no significant technical confounder; cross-modal support is largely WXS-driven, which is a noted limitation but not a basis for dropping the candidate.
